exit_reason: CQL-14 SKEPTIC complete: 6 issues found, fixed, and verified; no open issues.

config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-14: CQL - Date/Time Operators Part 2. SKEPTIC independently retested current code state across translated CQL, native-loaded DuckDB, forced Python fallback, and no-Python/browser-style C++ helper surfaces.

issues.title: TimeOfDay translation returned DuckDB TIME WITH TIME ZONE instead of CQL time text
issues.evidence: Focused TimeOfDay component and same-second parity tests pass across forced Python fallback and native-loaded registration.

issues.title: Direct current-clock helpers had Python versus C++ lexical shape divergence
issues.evidence: dateTimeNow() and dateTimeTimeOfDay() shape probes pass across forced Python fallback, native-loaded registration, and no-Python C++.

issues.title: Time constructor accepted static non-Integer components and malformed millisecond output
issues.evidence: Time(true, 0) and Time(12.5, 0) raise translation errors; Time(12, 0, 0, 1000) returns NULL across Python and native-loaded registration.

issues.title: Invalid precision names diverged between Python fallback and native C++
issues.evidence: cqlSameAsP(..., 'bogus') and translated week precision probes return NULL consistently across Python and C++.

issues.title: Direct dateTimeSame* helpers bypassed timezone-normalizing uncertainty-aware semantics
issues.evidence: dateTimeSameAs timezone and coarser-precision probes now match cqlSameAsP across Python, native-loaded, and no-Python C++.

issues.title: No-Python C++ dateSubtractQuantity truncated fractional date-only day quantities
issues.evidence: dateSubtractQuantity('2024-01-01', '{"value":0.5,"unit":"day"}') returns 2023-12-31 in Python, native-loaded, and no-Python C++.
